lines: La la la, la la la, la la la la
It's too late to say anything now, but
I can't stand the way you act
So considerate, such a good listener
Keeping secrets is second nature too
And even with the outlandish types
You mimic them with practiced ease
A living textbook of virtue
Never letting a grievance slip out
Everyone, absolutely everyone, becomes
Your ally
And still I won't forgive you
I won't accept it
Let's dodge all eyes and go — la la la, la la la, la la la la
Only death gets sent to all — la la la, la la la, la la la la
Let's run on jealousy — la la la, la la la, la la la la
The suckling child turns and attacks — la la la, la la la, la la la la
La la la, la la la, la la la la
I don't think I'm good
But the thought of you being good makes me sick
And yet the eyes of this world see clearly
Night falls while I argue with myself
Logic, ethics, stock phrases
Even hard evidence
None of it works on me
I can't hear it
Kill the meaning and be done — la la la, la la la, la la la la
Go mad with love and be done — la la la, la la la, la la la la
I always sing with a curse — la la la, la la la, la la la la
It passes my cheek and trails down — la la la, la la la, la la la la
You're drunk on your own sermonizing, I see
You're an individualist too, after all
Living without making enemies
In the end, that's beyond you
Let's dodge all eyes and go — la la la, la la la, la la la la
Only death gets sent to all — la la la, la la la, la la la la
Let's run on jealousy — la la la, la la la, la la la la
The suckling child turns and attacks — la la la, la la la, la la la la
La la la, la la la, la la la la
La la la, la la la, la la la la
La la la, la la la, la la la la
